observation.visible_scene: Backlit silhouette of a couple standing face-to-face on a wet sandy beach, holding hands, with the low sun directly behind them producing a bright starburst and a horizontal lens-flare streak. Breaking ocean waves and a dark rock sit on the right of the horizon; the figures' reflections stretch across the glistening wet sand in the foreground.
visible_changes: The woman's near (left) leg, held bent with the foot lifted off the ground at the start, gradually lowers until both feet appear planted by the end of the clip.
The background surf continuously breaks and recedes throughout the excerpt (a separate, ongoing process, not a single wave event).

There is a slow, slight apparent enlargement/repositioning of the scene: the couple and the right-side rock grow marginally and the sun appears to sit closer to the gap between their heads, consistent with a gentle camera push-in or drift.
The foreground reflection of the woman's leg changes shape as the raised foot comes down.
The couple's mutual position (facing, hands joined) and the man's upright posture remain essentially constant relative to each other.
outside_clip_unknowns: What the couple do after the foot is planted or before the clip begins.
The cause or extent of the apparent camera movement, and whether the figures themselves shift weight.
Whether the leg motion is a deliberate step or a resting pose being released.
uncertain_details: Whether the slight scale/position change is camera motion or the couple shifting, since the constantly moving waves and the single static rock give weak reference.
Exact frame at which the woman's foot fully touches the sand.
Clothing details (bikini top, shorts) are inferred only from silhouette outlines.
